claim: The top-level $1C6A signboard menu has closed branch semantics: Game Options enters the configuration loop, Play TDII advances into the downstream $0202 corridor, and High Score enters the L00A3CC surface before returning to the top menu.

transitions.label: Game Options
transitions.follow_on_surface: The installed callback uses 1E:8000 rows 0x15..0x1B for the control/sound settings labels.

transitions.label: Play TDII
transitions.follow_on_surface: L008B31 falls through to L008B3E and enters the separate $0202/$1C78 three-slot front-end corridor.

transitions.label: High Score
transitions.follow_on_surface: The high-score path enters L00A3CC and then returns to the top menu loop.
